# Beads issues whose acceptance criteria the check protects.
#
# Generated by scripts/check-bead-acceptance.sh --update-baseline.
#
# An issue listed here fails the gate when its acceptance criteria are
# gone, when they are whitespace only, or when the issue is missing from
# the list the gate read. An issue missing from here is not checked.
# bd omits the field when it is empty, so a wipe and a bead that never
# had acceptance criteria are the same output; this list is the record of
# which is which. Regenerate it after a bead gains acceptance criteria.
# An id that still exists with no text is a wipe: the command refuses to
# regenerate until the text is back, so this list only shrinks when an id
# leaves the tracker.
